text:
Documentation Recipes by Mac memory Blog Developer Slack ( hw-metal) 
 

vLLM Metal is a plugin that enables vLLM to run on Apple Silicon Macs using MLX as the primary compute backend. It unifies MLX and PyTorch under a single lowering path.

---
 Latest News 🔥

- [2026/11] MiniCPM-o 4.5 now supports concurrent duplex audio/video conversations on Apple Silicon through vLLM-Omni.
- [2026/11] D3 (Decision 3.0) support is now available on MLX for text-only choice, yes/no, and score requests. See the structured decisions guide.
- [2026/11] Text-to-image generation is now supported through vLLM-Omni, starting with SDXL.
- [2026/10] Experimental Recursive Flint INT4 support is now available on the MLX backend, including concurrent serving.
- [2026/10] DiffusionGemma now supports Jev-like System 1 decisions on Metal, with median decision latency under 0.2 s on an M5 Pro. See the structured decisions guide.
- [2026/10] Desktop inference competes with your other applications for memory. Sleep mode lets an idle model server return memory to those apps without shutting down. Read Abhigith Neil Abraham's walkthrough.
- [2026/10] Run local models with vLLM Metal through llmman. See the setup recipe.
- [2026/09] SiliconBench, which evaluates vLLM Metal and other serving engines on speed, memory use, and output fidelity, was accepted at NeurIPS 2026's Evaluations and Datasets Track.
- [2026/09] Read our official vLLM announcement, covering concurrent serving on Apple Silicon and v0.28.0.
- [2026/08] vLLM Metal now uses M5 NAX tensor units to accelerate MHA, GQA, and MQA prefill.
- [2026/08] Qwen3.8 now runs on Metal! mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-8bit serves a 27B hybrid SDPA + GDN linear model on a single Apple Silicon Mac.
- [2026/04] We released the new version v0.2.0! Unified paged varlen Metal kernel is now the default attention backend. 83x TTFT, 3.6x throughput compared to v0.1.0.

---

 Architecture

Upstream vLLM supplies the API server, scheduler, and paged block manager; mlx lm supplies the token-wise model layers; vllm-metal owns the request-aware attention path — the paged varlen kernel, M5 NAX prefill, and speculative decoding.

 

 Requirements

- macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later, on Apple Silicon

 Supported Models

vllm-metal supports a growing set of models on Apple Silicon. See the full matrix in docs/supported models.md.

 Installation

- Stable release: Install with Homebrew, then run vllm without activating an environment.

 

- Latest development build: Use the curl installer, then activate its environment. No compiler needed.

 

- Contributing Python or kernel code: Follow the source setup for an editable checkout and native build tools.

install.title: Installation
install.html:
• Stable release: Install with Homebrew, then run vllm without activating an environment.

    brew tap vllm-project/vllm-metal https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal
brew install vllm-project/vllm-metal/vllm-metal

  • Latest development build: Use the curl installer, then activate its environment. No compiler needed.

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal/main/install.sh | bash
source ~/.venv-vllm-metal/bin/activate

  • Contributing Python or kernel code: Follow the source setup for an editable checkout and native build tools.
